plugins.name: clean-examples
plugins.description: Module clean-examples of the app Clean Language, layers 0 and 1: the rules of how a Clean example is written, the audit of the examples of a layer (/clean-examples:audit), and a hook that refuses a malformed example as it is written

plugins.name: clean-derived-norms
plugins.description: Module clean-derived-norms of the app Clean Language, layer 2: the derived norms of Clean, one generator per type - the Lark grammar of Clean (/clean-derived-norms:derive-grammar) and its semantics in Lean 4 (/clean-derived-norms:derive-semantics) - each writing its list of derived norms, every derived norm with its own ID and fingerprint - run by /norms-management:build
